# Chris Swanson

> Principal GenAI Security Architect. Security architect and engineer: systems thinking, AI security, and building teams that ship.

This site is an interactive resume. The same content is available in plain formats:

## Resume

- [resume.md](resume.md): the full resume as markdown
- [resume.json](resume.json): the full resume as structured JSON
- [index.html?view=text](index.html?view=text): the resume as a plain web page

## WebMCP tools

In a browser that supports WebMCP (document.modelContext), index.html registers these tools:

- `get_profile`: Name, title, summary, skills and contact links for Chris Swanson.
- `list_experience`: Every role held, most recent first, as "Company: Role (dates) [id: …]" lines. Use the id with get_experience.
- `get_experience`: Full details (role, dates, summary, highlights, tags) for one company.
- `get_resume`: The whole resume, as markdown (default) or JSON.
- `set_view`: Switch the page between the 3D valley, the plain text resume, and the agent view.
- `show_company`: Show one company to the person viewing the page: opens its card in 3D or scrolls to it in text.
